name: fpac-soil-mcp
description: FastMCP server for USDA NRCS Soil Data Access and preliminary FPPA farmland classification screening

tools.name: get_farmland_classification_by_point
tools.description: Query USDA NRCS Soil Data Access for soil map units and Farmland Classification at a WGS84 point.

tools.name: get_farmland_classification_by_mukey
tools.description: Query USDA NRCS Soil Data Access for soil map unit attributes by map unit key (mukey).

tools.name: analyze_farmland_by_polygon
tools.description: Execute comprehensive FPPA preliminary screening on a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon AOI with exact spatial clipping.

tools.name: get_soil_polygons_by_geometry
tools.description: Retrieve intersecting SSURGO soil map unit polygon geometries and attributes as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection.

tools.name: check_urban_area_exemption
tools.description: Screen a project footprint against Census Bureau 2020 Urban Area boundaries (Layer 0).

tools.name: get_soil_interpretations
tools.description: Retrieve component-weighted soil interpretations from USDA NRCS SDA; supports the validated national NCCPI productivity index with generic productivity_rating, productivity_rating_class, and productivity_rating_source outputs. The source provenance identifier is SDA:NCCPI_V3. The removed nccpi_rating and nccpi_class aliases are not part of the public schema.

tools.name: calculate_preliminary_lesa
tools.description: Calculate unified candidate Land Evaluation (LE) and Site Assessment (LESA) scores for site (Form AD-1006) and corridor (Form NRCS-CPA-106) projects under 7 CFR Part 658.

tools.name: analyze_corridor_fppa
tools.description: Execute multi-county corridor screening using a line geometry whose centerline represents the corridor; polygon or MultiPolygon corridor geometry is not representable. Supports buffer_distance, buffer_units (feet, meters, or miles), optional indirect_geometry and alternatives, requested productivity_index (`NCCPI`), and optional max_county_rating_override. A validated override is used for normalization; otherwise the per-area-symbol county benchmark is used. Results use generic productivity_rating, productivity_rating_class, and productivity_rating_source fields with the SDA:NCCPI_V3 provenance identifier; nccpi_rating and nccpi_class aliases are intentionally removed.

tools.name: explain_fppa_screening_scope
tools.description: Explain the scope and limitations of FPPA preliminary screening vs full LESA evaluation.

tools.name: list_farmland_classes
tools.description: List all standard NRCS farmland classification categories with definitions and regulatory context.
